prompt.project_info: Create a moody minimalist urban fashion portrait of one approved adult woman standing against a modern concrete wall.
prompt.main_subject: Adult woman with hair tied in a neat low bun, sleek sunglasses, minimalist jewelry, and an all-black outfit consisting of a long coat and refined streetwear layers. Preserve her confident profile and clean silhouette.
composition_elements: Standing portrait against a modern concrete wall.
Sharp cast shadow of the subject on the wall.
Minimal architectural background with clean lines and no distractions.
Black coat, sunglasses, low bun, and jewelry form a restrained monochrome composition.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Directional moody light with crisp shadow geometry, subdued urban palette, high-fashion street-style atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic fashion photography, realistic coat and concrete texture, crisp focus, controlled contrast, editorial composition, no text or watermark.
